sources.entry: CloudyTabs - Simple menu bar macOS application for displaying lists of your iCloud Tabs and Reading List.

summary.one_liner: CloudyTabs is a small macOS menu bar app that lists your iCloud Tabs (open tabs from other devices) and Reading List so you can open them on your Mac.
summary.what_it_does: It runs as a menu bar application and shows a list of open tabs from your iCloud-synced devices, plus your Reading List. Selecting a tab opens its URL in your default browser. Cmd-selecting or Cmd-Return opens the tab in the background, and Opt-selecting or Opt-Return copies the URL instead. Typing the first few letters of a tab's title jumps to that tab. Hovering over the menu bar icon shows a tooltip with the date iCloud last updated the synced tabs database or Bookmarks plist that the app reads from.
use_cases: view Safari tabs open on my iPhone or iPad on my Mac
open an iOS tab in Chrome or another default browser
browse Safari Reading List from the menu bar
copy a URL from another device's open tabs
quickly search through synced tabs by title
how_to_run: Download CloudyTabs and copy it to your Applications folder.
Alternatively, with Homebrew cask set up, run: brew cask install cloudytabs
notable: Menu bar app listing iCloud Tabs from all synced devices
Includes Reading List alongside open tabs
Modifier keys: Cmd opens in background, Opt copies the URL
Type-to-jump search by tab title or URL prefix
Tooltip shows when iCloud last synced the tabs data
caveats: README does not describe ongoing maintenance status
keywords: chrome on mac safari on ios
